target_seq.description: the 1-based log sequence of the target event. The context at the rewind equals the context at the target. The minimum keyword and the earlier-than-self rule (target_seq below the event's own seq) are outside the validator subset; the producer enforces them (docs/rewind-fork-design.md section 3).

mode.description: 'before': the target is excluded from the model context (a user message restored to the input box, unsent). 'on': the target is included in the context. The enum keyword is outside the validator subset; the producer enforces it.

reason.description: optional producer note. v1 value: tui_pick.
